test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: In the Parliament of India, the purpose of an adjournment motion is:

options.text: to allow a discussion on a definite matter of urgent public importance
to let opposition members collect information from the ministers
to allow a reduction of specific amount in demand for grant
to postpone the proceedings to check the inappropriate or violent behaviour on the part of some members

solution: The correct answer is **__option 1.__** __** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** • In the Parliament of India, the purpose of an adjournment motion is to allow a discussion on a definite matter of urgent public importance.
